messages:
maria: PR #2389 - replacing env secret fetcher with sidecar token fetcher. Adds optional HSM integration for air-gapped clusters. Need sec review for egress policy and secret persistence.

alex: quick q — what's token TTL and caching behavior? If we cache to disk that changes threat model a lot.

maria: TTL is 15m currently; caching was using local file in /var/lib/app/creds (bad). plan is to mount tmpfs /run/creds and store tokens there, also rotate every 15m. draft diff: ```yaml
volumeMounts:
  - name: creds
    mountPath: /run/creds
    readOnly: false
volumes:
  - name: creds
    emptyDir:
      medium: Memory
```

lee: high level: ok but need explicit threat model + runbook. don't persist plaintext on disk, ensure SA scope is narrow. Add network egress allowlist to only HSM endpoints. Also add an env var `SECURE_FETCHER=1` not to fallback to file system.

sre-ops: note re: private clusters in eu-west, HSM over private-link requires VPC endpoint + route table update. We can't use public endpoints. Example: create vpce-id vpce-0a1b2c and add route table association. also ensure NAT/GW not exposing traffic to internet.

sec-bot: secret-scan CI: FOUND potential secret-like string in 3 files -> false positives for generated certs. HIGH: token file path referenced `/var/lib/app/creds/token`. Please remove or update to tmpfs before merge.

maria: already updated PR to tmpfs mount and added `security.redwood/avoid-disk-cache: "true"` annotation. Also added smoke test that ensures no file present after app stop. pushed new commit.

lee: lgtm after adding a short e2e in CI that simulates node reboot and verifies token not persisted. also add runbook step for emergency revoke.

tom: schedule merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT if sec is happy. can someone confirm deploy has canary off by default?

maria: confirmed — canary disabled, will flip on in a separate roll. merging tomorrow on ack from lee.

alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
